# Controlled preview fixtures

A.docx and B.docx are original synthetic OOXML archives containing the literal
text Controlled attachment A/B, one embedded 1x1 PNG, and an original 1,148-byte
AttachmentSmoke TrueType font with rectangle glyphs. No customer document,
remote reference or third-party font is included. The all-zero OOXML font key
makes its reversible obfuscation the identity operation. These files support
real docx-preview parsing, image/font results and lifetime isolation checks.
They are test inputs, not shipped customer media.
